title: 05's button radius rule matches the web's buttons and the owner's pill decision
acceptance: 05-components › Buttons states one radius rule for buttons that matches what the web ships and the owner's 2026-11-22 decision that the Mac's buttons take the shipped web's pill (iOS RF-1207). Today 05 says buttons take the input radius (12 px) and "pills are reserved for chips and compact tags".
Where the rule and the web's buttons disagree, the web's buttons are brought into line in this task or in a named child task, and 08's rows still describe both platforms correctly.
nextAction: In progress (Neo conductor, branch fix/rf-236-button-radius). The owner set the scope in session on 2026-11-23: buttons are pills from the sm width (640 px) up, as on the Mac, and keep the control radius (10 px) below it, as on the iPhone. Restart: edit 05 › Buttons to that rule; give the 11 copper primaries that break it (7 rounded-control only, 4 rounded-input) and Login's Apple button `rounded-control sm:rounded-pill`; update 08's Sign in with Apple row; file a child Backlog task for the secondary buttons; run the full gate; then ask the owner to merge. 08 changes, so an iOS web-contract refresh PR follows the merge.

Buttons: "Radius input (12px); pills are reserved for chips and compact tags." Read on main dbc663c.
